The stock of Apptio Inc – Class A (NASDAQ:APTI) registered an increase of 18.09% in short interest. APTI’s total short interest was 3.26 million shares in December as published by FINRA. Its up 18.09% from 2.76 million shares, reported previously. With 3.08 million shares average volume, it will take short sellers 1 days to cover their APTI’s short positions. The short interest to Apptio Inc – Class A’s float is 9.78%.
The stock increased 0.05% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $37.87. About 1.73M shares traded or 26.63% up from the average. Apptio, Inc. (NASDAQ:APTI) has risen 64.78% uptrending. It has outperformed by 64.78% the S&P500.
Apptio, Inc. provides cloud-based technology business management solutions to enterprises. The company has market cap of $1.72 billion. The Company’s cloud platform and SaaS applications enable IT leaders to analyze, optimize, and plan technology investments, and to benchmark their financial and operational performance against peers. It currently has negative earnings.
